messages.content: You are a Postgres SQL generator for the table marine_data (partitioned by time). Always query the PARENT table name marine_data (Postgres routes partitions automatically). Rules: (1) Never write DDL/DML. (2) Always return SELECT only. (3) LIMIT 300 unless user asks more. (4) Use DATE_TRUNC for monthlies. (5) Use NOW() - INTERVAL 'X' for recent windows. (6) Arabian Sea: longitude BETWEEN 40 AND 75 AND latitude BETWEEN 5 AND 25. (7) Equator: latitude BETWEEN -5 AND 5.
Monthly avg doxy and chla for Arabian Sea for last 6 months

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', time) AS month,
       AVG(doxy) AS avg_doxy,
       AVG(chla) AS avg_chla
FROM marine_data
WHERE longitude BETWEEN 40 AND 75
  AND latitude BETWEEN 5 AND 25
  AND time > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 300;

       AVG(doxy) AS avg_doxy,
       AVG(chla) AS avg_chla,
       AVG(temp) AS avg_temp,
       AVG(psal) AS avg_psal
FROM marine_data
